title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: Technics RS-1506 > Grace designs Lunatec V3 (pre only) > Korg MR-1000 > DSD-DFF 1bit 5.64 Mhz > Audio Gate SW > 24/96 WAV

ai_review.summary: Good 4/19/82 show with Peggy‑O and They Love Each Other shining, but the early‑'82 SBD mix is thin on bass making it sound bright.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for standout renditions of Peggy‑O, They Love Each Other, and a solid Franklin's Tower, with Garcia’s guitar described as tasty and Phil’s intro bass highlighted. However, reviewers note the soundboard recording lacks low end typical of first‑half‑82 mixes, resulting in a bright, somewhat thin overall sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised (high energy, strong song performances) while recording quality is noted as lacking bass, leading to an overall solid but not exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early‑'82 SBD mix noticeably thin on bass and bright; vocals and guitars clear, but low‑end is weak compared to later 1982 recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard two‑set structure with strong first‑set highlights and a solid second set; no specific pacing issues mentioned.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar work described as tasty and enjoyable.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's intro bass is well recorded, though overall mix lacks low end.
